description: SiYuan is a privacy-first, self-hosted personal knowledge management system: block-based notes with bidirectional links, a visual graph, flashcards and rich export — your own local-first notebook, synced through your server.
name: SiYuan
seoDescription: Deploy SiYuan with Docker Compose on Dokploy — the privacy-first, self-hosted knowledge management and note-taking system with block references and graph view.
